text: The property did not experience tree-cover loss in 2024 or 2025. The latest observed tree-cover loss event occurred in 2023, affecting 4.5 hectares (0.12% of the asset). Data from Hansen's Global Forest Change (GFC-2025-v1.13) and JRC's Global Forest Cover 2020 confirm this, with no further losses recorded in 2024 or 2025. Small patches of loss under 0.5 hectares (e.g., 0.3 ha in 2022 and 1.3 ha in 2023) were also noted but do not meet the 0.5-hectare minimum event area threshold. The asset remains predominantly forested, with 92.63% classified as forest in 2020.
